comment: Commit c37193d on branch puffy-rc3 carries version 2.9.1 and a plugin.json byte-identical to the installed one; that is the build read. The module is a Make Noise Maths emulation and the maker keeps the Maths manual in doc/manuals. Panel lettering names the rise and fall controls SURGE and SINK and the shape control CURVE, while the maker's tooltips call them rise, fall and shape; the lines follow the panel. The shape-mode switch carries no printed label. EoR on channel 1 is high for the whole of the fall and EoC on channel 4 is high for the whole of the rise, which is the Maths behaviour but is not what either abbreviation suggests. Self-cycling is held to 1000Hz and external triggering to 2000Hz by enforceOuterSpeedLimit, which stretches both stage times when the pair would run faster. The curve previews and the crystal button are plain widgets with no parameter behind them, so no click on them reaches this feature.
